# WineDB — Relational Fine Wine & Vintage Varietal Database

> WineDB is a 3NF-normalized relational dataset of fine wine producers, cuvees and vintages: 3,675 vintage records, 106 winery records, 143 cuvees and 57 appellations, with varietal blend percentages (database-enforced `SUM <= 100.001%`), tasting descriptors and a 3,746-row `data_sources` table. How each field is made is documented in the data dictionary.

## Key Links & Documentation

## Core Capabilities & Specs
- **Data Formats:** Full snapshot ships as a 3NF SQLite relational database (`winedb.sqlite`), a SQL dump, 7 normalized CSV exports and 7 JSON files; the free sample ships as a SQLite preview plus 6 CSVs.
- **Data Sources:** See [Sources](https://winedb.dataengineered.io/SOURCES.md) and the field notes in the [Data Dictionary](https://winedb.dataengineered.io/DATA_DICTIONARY.md).
- **Attribution:** Free sample data and docs are Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0); the full commercial snapshot is distributed under a Commercial Database License with perpetual commercial rights and monthly refreshed updates.
